newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring ends higher in technical bounce.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring ends higher in technical bounce.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended higher on a technical bounce, but traders said volumes were slack and there were few big players.

"Even a dead cat will bounce if you throw it off a tall building, and that's essentially what we saw today," a trader said. "This was some tiny short-covering.... on feelings that yesterday's drop was overdone. Not any big feature here."
Traders reported seeing some inter-market spreading, with players selling MGE March and buying the CBOT equivalent.
Wheat also was buoyed by a surge in soybeans on forecasts for cooler temperatures.
MGE spring wheat closed steady to three cents per bushel higher, with Dec up 1/2 cent at $4.07-1/2. Sept gained three cents to close at $4.27.
LFG sold 1.5 million March bushels. Benson-Quinn bought 1.5 million Dec and sold 800,000 Dec, traders said.
The MGE estimated Tuesday's spring wheat volume at 17.545 million bushels, compared to 21.505 million Monday.
MGE barley futures settled four to six cents per hundredweight lower, with Dec down six cents at $7.17.
